posts.title: Halloween 2026 + Gameplay Update
posts.text:
As Halloween draws near, the residents of The Cursed Apple have put out some decorations to celebrate their favorite holiday. The Hideout gains a spooky new look, our heroes don masks, and NYC is now littered with pumpkins and curious Halloween Cauldrons that grant willing trick-or-treaters delicious candy.

New this year - Halloween Cauldrons: break a cauldron with a Heavy Melee to pick up a piece of Candy and stash it in your pocket. Consume the candy to grant yourself a boost of energy with the temporary Sugar Rush buff. The Halloween festivities are available in-game now through November 2nd, 2026.

Gameplay Update highlights:
- Mid-Boss: health increased by 20%, bounty reduced from 3000 (+50/min) to 1500 (+25/min); the Rejuvenator now drops as 3 crystals placed evenly around the pit
- Comeback gold from non-hero sources increased from 26% to 30%; Haunts bounty and growth increased by 10%
- Move speed in tunnels reduced from +70% to +50%; Steam Vents now increase stamina regeneration by 150%
- The latest 6 heroes are no longer categorized as "new": normal ranked unlock requirements apply and they can now be banned

Items: High-Velocity Rounds bullet velocity 60% → 45%; Glass Cannon weapon damage 80% → 85%; Shadow Weave reworked (+50% Ambush weapon damage instead of fire rate/melee, builds up over 6s); Bullet/Spirit Lifesteal 13% → 15%; Metal Skin now increases gravity by 20% while active; and more.

Heroes: Abrams base gun damage +5%; Nurse Harrow base gun damage −10%; Mirage Traveler reworked (channel 2s → 3s, T2 −65s Cooldown, T3 cannot be interrupted by damage); Solomon base bullet damage 30 → 25; Rat King base bullet damage −5%; Violet Still Life rework and more.

Полный список изменений — по ссылке на источник.

posts.title: Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit.
posts.text:
It's hard to know if that chill in the air is from the approaching fall breeze, or from the withering glare of Nurse Harrow, who now joins us on the streets of Manhattan. To some, her practices may seem unorthodox, her patients at the Marble Hill Possession Ward cannot say that the results aren't effective. With Leech Therapy, she throws a jar full of leeches that attach to oncoming enemies, draining their health and energy, before crawling back to deliver their haul. Cracking open one of her vials, she releases her Wretched Vapors, possessing her allies with a powerful boost of effectiveness - though subjects should be warned of the side effects when the vapors wear off. To efficiently keep her teammates fighting their best, she loads her syringe full of Healing Needles to inject medicine directly into their veins. And when her patience runs out, she opens her bag to release all the Lurking Terrors captured inside, making her adversaries run for cover. - "Trust me, I know best."

With Nurse Harrow joining us today, that marks the end of our City Never Sleeps releases. We want to ...

posts.title: Paint the Town
posts.text:
Brush in hand, Violet approaches the ritual with the same precision she does her art, wielding Living Ink that both empowers her bullets, and draws mere inspiration into reality. When entering Flow State, her ink glides easily, weaving towards danger to deal damage, or away from it to make a quick getaway. By creating a Still Life Violet can truly capture her enemies' likeness to stunning results. And with Abstract Landscape she surrounds herself and those nearby with her biggest and most ambitious piece yet, leaving onlookers completely speechless. - "I worked too hard to get here, I can't stop now."

Violet is available in-game now! Which means that our final hero - Nurse Harrow - will be joining us Next Tuesday October 20th at 2pm PDT. We want to thank everyone for participating in voting once again, and we'll see you next week for the culmination of our City Never Sleeps update. Have a good weekend!

posts.title: Fairfax Industries Employee Spotlight
posts.text:
Today, Fairfax Industries is proud to introduce their most valuable salesman: Deadman Danny. Wielding a rocket launcher and flying high above the streets of New York (courtesy of the Chimera Mk1 - the latest and greatest in self-adhered aviation technology), Danny rains his Strix Salvo missiles down upon foes, marking them for future attacks. Jettison Fuel is a handy trick that both expels heat from the Chimera System, while also dousing nearby enemies in the warm embrace of a fiery inferno. Yet his most impressive tactic has always been his ability to Close the Deal, wowing prospective customers with an explosive hands-on demonstration of all that Fairfax has to offer. - "At Fairfax Industries we say "All's Fair", but that's not true! Because with the Fairfax Chimera Mark 1, you have the advantage."

Take flight with Deadman Danny, available in-game now! With only two hero releases remaining, keep your votes coming to help determine who will be joining us on Friday October 16th at 2pm PDT.

posts.title: Make Your Move.
posts.text:
Solomon remains calm and collected when facing a new challenger, so when the Patrons come calling, he approaches the city as if it's one giant chessboard. With Setup Bishop he advances, planting his loyal damage dealers ahead of him and sliding them across the streets with ease. Kingside Knight comes into play when it's time for defense, granting protection to allies and making tactical retreats when needed. Rook Battery charges forward with great force, stalling enemies in their tracks. And with his final move, Develop Queen, he locks down his enemies in an ultimate checkmate. - "There's a lot you can learn from losing to a master."

Solomon is available in-game now (just in time for National Chess Day)! We're halfway through our latest set of heroes, keep your votes coming to help determine who will be joining us next Tuesday at 2pm PDT. Have a great weekend!

posts.title: Mind the Birds!
posts.text:
It was a close contest, but today we find New York's notorious pigeon lady leaving her favorite perch in Central Park and joining the fight on the city streets. 

Tourists in the park might not think much of ol' Baba sitting on her bench - sipping tea and talking to her birds - but the locals have always suspected that something more brews below the surface. In the heat of battle, Baba throws out her Threadsap, a chaotic spool of yarn that steals the very spirit of her enemies, granting her greater power. While her legs might not be what they used to, her trusty bench comes to life with a creak of metal, allowing her to run, jump, and kick with impressive vigor. Parkgoers know it's best to stay on Baba's good side, as at tea time you might find yourself splashed with one of Baba's Brews (some of them much sweeter than others), and when tea time is over - The Birds come out to play... "They think they know magic? Oh I'll show 'em some magic."

Baba and her pigeons are available now! We'll see you back here on Friday at 2pm PDT to introduce our next hero.

posts.title: City Never Sleeps
posts.text:
The Cursed Apple is ever changing, and these streets are nothing like you remember. A massive visual update to the map and neutrals, six new heroes, HUD updates, numerous quality-of-life additions, accessibility options, and more.

Check out everything that's new at: https://www.playdeadlock.com/cityneversleeps

We also wanted to take this opportunity to talk about where we are with the development of the game and what to look forward to in the future. Our team has been incredibly happy and surprised with how passionate and supportive the community has been the past couple of years; every day someone shares something cool they've seen from the community with the rest of the team, and we are thankful for the constant support and useful feedback, despite the game being unfinished. We think building a multiplayer game is very hard and risky, and the best way to minimize that risk to make sure that we are able to have it in players' hands from an early state to help us shape it and tell us what is fun and what isn't. So, we wanted to give you all more insight into what we've been ...

posts.title: Matchmaking Update
posts.text:
This update includes a revamp to how the matchmaking system works, as well as the introduction of a new matchmaking mode. You can now choose to play in Standard Mode (unranked), or the new Ranked Mode introduced in this update.

STANDARD MODE
Standard mode provides a lower-stakes way to play Deadlock with friends, without worrying about adjustments your Rank. There are no restrictions on party size or skill spread. You can also play in this mode to practice heroes you are less familiar with, as the matchmaker will adjust the game it puts you in to account for your experience with that hero. 

RANKED MODE
Ranked mode gives players a way to queue up for more competitive games against similarly-skilled players with higher stakes. Each season you'll be able to climb the Ranks and see how far you can go.

UPDATED RANKS & BADGES:

posts.title: Apollo - A Cut Above
posts.text:
Apollo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164767/0aab19877fe18e934963918a7cb4f80364adc22d.png

After weeks of waiting, Apollo finally graces us with his presence. With Flawless Advance the fencer begins his approach, timing his strikes perfectly to inflict more damage. Counter-attacks aren't a concern for Apollo, as a flourish of his blade deflects the damage and triggers a quick Riposte, and Disengaging Sigil allows him to jump out of the fray with ease. For his final blow, Apollo dons his fencer's mask and channels Ixia's might with Itani Lo Sahn, leaving enemies defeated in his wake. - "Sa la rex vogali!"

With Apollo's release, that concludes the rollout of our Old Gods, New Blood update. Thank you to everyone for the warm welcome of our new Patrons, getting your hands dirty in Street Brawl, and voting for your favorite heroes!

 Exactly 600 people had the foresight to only vote for the eventual winner each round
 The largest winning margin was Venator over Celeste at 11%

posts.title: Introducing The Dazzling Celeste
posts.text:
Come one, come all! Today, we're introducing...

Celeste
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164767/a8b1361481f9292802bb6592cf79733971efa76f.png

It's not every day that Coney Island's biggest star, The Dazzling Celeste, performs on the streets of Manhattan. Her show begins with Light Eater, where a deep breath lit by her blazing baton coats enemies in front of her, and grants increased damage against them. Following that up, she envelops herself in the prismatic shield of her Dazzling Trick, which explodes and silences nearby enemies who break it. Try not to get distracted by her gliding gracefully through the air, or by the dance of her Radiant Daggers, as you'll regret being underneath them when they rain down from above. As for her memorable final act, the Shining Wonder will make her allies go OOH and her foes go AGGHHH! - "You are about to see something rare and wonderful!"

Celeste is available to play in-game now! Join us on Thursday Feb 12th at 2pm for the release of Apollo and the conclusion of our Old Gods, New Blood update. We'll see you then!

posts.title: Some Are Merciful, The Venator Is Not
posts.text:
Evil stirs in New York, and the Venator is here to answer.

Venator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164767/a8fcf6c0e81b0fc764cb294caeba6cfd583e69a3.png

Venator doesn't walk the righteous path, he blazes the trail so that others may do so safely. His biggest challenge is knowing which weapon to use first. Firing a Consecrating Grenade into the fray softens up his enemies and keeps them from restoring health, and his Hex-Lined Snap Trap scatters across the ground to lock them in place. A Gutshot from his shotgun will knock back enemies who get too close, and when the time is right, Ira Domini will rid the world of evil once and for all. - "Today, nine commandments will have to do."

Venator joins the ritual now. The countdown for our final two heroes is upon us, and we'll see you back here on Monday February 9th at 2pm PST for our next release!

posts.title: The Curse Beckons for Silver
posts.text:
The votes are in and today's addition to the Cursed Apple is...

Silver
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164767/0841efa2500ec2bf46ca991f4df8150748d8defa.png

Silver makes her living tracking down lowlifes, but today New York’s misanthrope lycanthrope plans on summoning a god. Fortunately, her career as a bounty hunter has prepared her well for all that the ritual requires. She makes quick work of adversaries by catching them with her Entangling Bola, Boot Kicking them in the face, and finishing them off with a Slam Fire from her rifle. But inevitably, the Lycan Curse comes calling whether she likes it or not, and her foes will regret being too close when it does. - "This should be easy. Won't be, but I'm really good at lying to myself."

Silver is available to play now! The next hero from the Old Gods, New Blood update will be released on Thursday February 5th at 2pm PST. See you then!

posts.title: Graves Prefers The Dead
posts.text:
Today's bone-chilling addition to the Cursed Apple is none other than...

Graves
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164767/c167b4a0c1c8e9df56e26fa7989e1b8d8c2e58e2.png

The dead have been making a whole lot of demands lately, and only Graves has the courage to oblige. That severed lich hand she found in the cemetery has proven itself a valuable ally, allowing her to latch onto her enemies and steal their power for herself. Her curiosities about the passage of life are further put to use with Jar of Dead, collecting the remains of the fallen, shaking them up, and throwing them back at her enemies to grant those remorseful spirits a final shot at revenge. With Grasping Hands she strikes a deep crack in the earth, allowing those down below to grab onto enemies' ankles and stop them from escaping her reach. And when all else fails, a Borrowed Decree will summon the dead to fight alongside her. - Death is coming.

Graves is available in-game now! Keep your votes coming over the weekend, as the third hero from our Old Gods, New Blood update will be released on Monday February 2nd at 2pm PST.

posts.title: Rem Enters The City That Never Sleeps
posts.text:
The people have spoken, and the first new addition from the Old Gods, New Blood update is...

Rem

An accidental stowaway from the world of dreams, Rem has found himself stranded in the city that never sleeps. Pillow fights are Rem's preferred form of conflict, tossing his favorite pillow at enemies to knock them back when they're getting too close. His friends, however, he likes to keep nearby - leaping to their aid when things get dicey and taking a quick nap on their shoulder. His Lil Helpers are curious creatures, taking interest in everything the streets of New York have to offer, and cheering on his allies as they go. Ultimately when Naptime hits, no one will be able to keep their eyes open. - The best part of being asleep, is being asleep.

Keep your votes coming, as the next hero will be released on Thursday at 2pm PST. See you then!

posts.title: You Can't Kill Victor
posts.text:
Hero Spotlight: Victor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164767/5f17579aa198931ee073ad9540e2b044b80ea333.png
A man who walks the line between life and death. Victor has learned to harness pain into power, shocking himself with Jumpstart to get his adrenaline rushing and his faulty heart pumping. He welcomes incoming damage with open (albeit mismatched) arms, channeling it into his Pain Battery and granting enemies a taste of the pain he endures. Get too close and risk getting caught in his Aura of Suffering, but hey, at least you'll be suffering together! And just when you think you've taken him down... Think again. - 'They don't have what it takes to kill me.'

With Victor joining us today in the Cursed Apple, that concludes the rollout of our Six Hero Update. Thank you to everyone for participating in voting, we have loved seeing all the discourse and heart-felt campaigns for your favorite heroes over the last two weeks.

posts.title: Drifter Emerges from the Shadows
posts.text:
Hero Spotlight: Drifter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164767/effac101dabe092cef4b6eacc2fe486de845816f.png
Something ancient has arrived in New York... a nameless horror known only as the Drifter. Relentless as time, as certain as death, once Drifter sets his eyes on a victim there's nothing they can do to stop him. They can try to run, but his Bloodscent drives him forward, leading him to isolated prey. Even if they manage to escape it doesn't matter, as Stalker's Mark allows Drifter to appear right behind his enemies before lunging in for the kill with a vicious Rend. Soon Eternal Night comes, and a faint whistling in the breeze will be joined by a chorus of screams. - 'Everyone's got weaknesses, but mercy ain't one of mine.'

You'll be able to find the Drifter lurking right behind you in games starting today. We'll be back here on Friday at 2pm PDT for the conclusion of our hero update with the release of Victor. See you then!

posts.title: Paige Writes Her Own Story
posts.text:
It's Monday, and today we're excited to announce the next hero joining us in the Cursed Apple is...

Hero Spotlight: Paige
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164767/32461f95d508f369b02dd703d0a9c254c037bb34.png
Citizens of Manhattan will learn to appreciate the power of the written word when Paige joins the fight. With the mere toss of a book she can Conjure Dragons that sear enemies who get too close, or bind them to the ground with Captivating Read. Waning allies will find themselves emboldened by Defend and Fight, granting them the courage to fight another day. Fantasy becomes reality with Rallying Charge, summoning an entire cavalry to gallop across the city. - 'We can't wait to see how this story plays out.'

Your votes will decide if Drifter or Victor will be joining us on Wednesday at 2pm PDT, we'll see you then!

posts.title: The Doorman, at your Service
posts.text:
Hero Spotlight: The Doorman
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164767/c92f11d8ea510f5eea50f229f2ad06a0e56ba708.png
He's proper, he's polite, but the humble Doorman of The Baroness Hotel is more than meets the eye. A brisk ring of his Call Bell leaves nearby enemies disoriented, and his high-speed Luggage Cart knocks them right off their feet. Do you find yourself getting lost easily in the streets of Manhattan? Don't worry, The Doorman is here to provide a shortcut with his Doorway whenever the need arises. And only the most special of enemies get to experience the trip of a lifetime to The Baroness Hotel. - Please, stay as long as you'd like.

You can check out The Doorman in game now. Keep your votes coming over the weekend as our next hero will be released on Monday August 25th at 2pm PST.

posts.title: Billy Comes in Swinging
posts.text:
The votes are in! Today we are excited to announce that the next hero joining us in the Cursed Apple is... Billy!

Hero Spotlight: Billy

A white hot ball of rage, furious at the very notion of... something. Billy is a chaotic front-liner who never backs down from a challenge. With Rising Ram he gets up close and personal, before slamming down with Bashdown to create shockwaves through his enemies. Running isn't even an option when Billy can use his ultimate Chain Gang to grapple enemies and pull them back in. A quick swig from his bottle gets him Blasted, and his enemies totally wrecked. - 'The hell are you staring at, buddy?'

Keep your votes coming. The next hero will be released at 2pm PST on Friday. See you then!

posts.title: Holliday, Vyper, Calico, and The Magnificent Sinclair
posts.text:
Today's update adds four new heroes to matchmaking: Holliday, Vyper, Calico, and The Magnificent Sinclair.

Expanding our roster is one of our major goals in 2025. While some of these characters have a much higher degree of temporary art than usual, we are excited to see how they perform on the battlefield. 

So who are the new faces you’ll be seeing on the streets of New York?

HOLLIDAY
Armed with an heirloom revolver and a spirit lasso, Holliday's investigations have led her to New York... and when she finds the killer she's looking for she's bringing him in dead, not alive.

VYPER
Did you know that when you slide your gun has infinite ammo? Vyper does. That’s why you’ll find her sliding around the battlefield spraying lead and poison.

THE MAGNIFICENT SINCLAIR
Mystify your rivals with combat tricks so vexing that they won’t believe their eyes! Summon a spectral assistant, polymorph foes into rabbits, and turn the enemies own abilities against them! Impossible? Not for THE MAGNIFICENT SINCLAIR…

CALICO
